ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.BypassValidationRules__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Sub_Publication_Request", On_Hold__c = TRUE, NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Work in progress"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Preview"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Validated") ) ) )
